source: derived: horizons marched over the global LOLA grid (0.5 degree cells, 30 cells, 24 azimuths); Earth direction from the JPL DE440 ephemerides every 6 h of 2027 (libration included)
note: Share of 2027 with the Earth above the regional horizon. The Earth is a point at infinity (Earth parallax of about 1 degree and the Sun's disc are not resolved) and terrain smaller than a 15 km cell is invisible, so rough ground is overstated. Not validated against NASA illumination products. Cells with an unreadable height are no data.
